blocks.title: Oscillatory motion (jhoolne wali harkat)
blocks.text: Oscillatory motion kisi darmiyani jagah ke gird aage peeche ki harkat hai. Yeh dauri harkat hai jo barabar waqfon ke baad khud ko dohrati hai.

items: Apni rest ki jagah se hataya gaya simple pendulum.
Spring ke sire par lagi kamiyat, ufqi ya amudi satah mein, kheench kar chhorne par.
Thos maddah ke atoms ya molecules jo apni darmiyani jagah ke gird jhoolte hain.
Hawa mein awaz ki lehrein chalne par hawa ke molecules.
Guitar aur violin jaise saazon ki taarein.

blocks.text: Har thartharane ya jhoolne wale jism ki aik tawazun (darmiyani) jagah hoti hai. Jab use is jagah se hataya jaye to aik restoring force use wapas lane ke liye amal karti hai, aur yahi thartharahat ya jhoolne ka sabab hai. Kitab ki ibtidai tasaveer (spring par kamiyat, pendulum, tuning fork, jhoola, guitar aur baaz) in misalon ki tasaveer aur khaake hain aur shamil nahi ki gayin.

items: Vibration: thartharate jism ka apni darmiyani jagah ke gird aik mukammal chakkar (cycle); maslan pendulum ka bob A se B aur wapas A tak.
Lamhati displacement (x): kisi lamhe par thartharate jism ka darmiyani jagah se faasla.
Amplitude (xo): darmiyani jagah ki kisi bhi taraf zyada se zyada displacement ki miqdar. Lehar ke liye amplitude le jayi jane wali tawanai ka paimana hai: amplitude jitna zyada, tawanai utni zyada.
Time period (T): aik vibration mukammal karne ka waqt; SI ikai second (s). T = 1/f = 2 pi / w.
Frequency (f): aik second mein mukammal vibrations ki tadaad, f = n/t = 1/T. Is ki ikai hertz (Hz), yani aik oscillation fi second; dimension [T^-1].
Angular frequency (w): fi ikai waqt angular displacement, w = theta/t. Aik chakkar mein theta = 2 pi radian aur waqt T, is liye w = 2 pi / T = 2 pi f. Is ki SI ikai rad s^-1 hai.

blocks.alt: Baen: sahare se latka simple pendulum; bob darmiyani jagah O par aur, dashed, inteha ki jagahon A aur B par, darmiyan mein mura rasta. O se B ka surkh teer amplitude xo = OB, aur note ke aik vibration A se B se A hai. Daen: displacement x, amplitude xo, time period T = 1/f, frequency f hertz mein, aur angular frequency w = 2 pi f = 2 pi / T ki tareefein.
blocks.caption: Oscillation ki istilahat (Fig 14.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Bob O ki dono taraf barabar faasle par do inteha ki jagahon ke darmiyan jhoolta hai. Amplitude O se aik inteha tak napa jata hai, aik inteha se doosri tak nahi.

blocks.prompt: Agar simple pendulum ka amplitude xo ho to bob aik vibration mein kitna faasla tay karta hai?
blocks.explanation: 4xo: aik inteha se O tak (xo), O se doosri inteha tak (xo), aur wapas (2xo).

blocks.prompt: Spring se bandhi machhli 20 second mein 10 vibrations karti hai. Is ka period aur frequency kya hain?

items: Oscillatory motion: darmiyani jagah ke gird dauri aage peeche harkat.
Istilahat: vibration, displacement, amplitude, T, f, w.
T = 1/f = 2 pi / w; w = 2 pi f.
